purpose: teach slot-1 (carrier slot 1) rotation angle by hand, motor de-energised

pose_before_teach.note: value before user rotated arm toward slot 1

carrier.state: commanded by direct TIM3 CCR4 write (action 8 blocked: lift top_valid=0)

root_cause_notes: Earlier result=4 ACK error with TEC=128 was a physical link fault (ACK from no node).
After re-soldering: ESR=0, but DM read still failed because the motor needs >1s after VM power-up before answering parameter reads.
Firmware reply timeout raised 150ms -> 1200ms and total 2000ms -> 15000ms; read then succeeds 7/7.
CAN1 re-serialisation was also fixed: CAN1 is now hardware-initialised once only, ABOM enabled, and CAN1 services are gated while a DM transaction is in flight.
boundary: This record proves the taught angle and read-back only. No motion, no enable, no mode change was commanded. Position-speed mode not yet verified.
